module TopModule (
    input  logic       clk,
    input  logic       reset,
    input  logic [7:0] d,
    output logic [7:0] q
);

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 8'hA5;
        end else begin
            q <= d;
        end
    end

endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  load,
    input  ena,
    input  [3:0] data,
    output reg [3:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            q <= 4'b0000;
        end else if (ena) begin
            q <= {1'b0, q[3:1]};
        end else if (load) begin
